verdict.rationale: Solid's README says its minimal abstractions give direct DOM access, making it easy to use native libraries like D3, and that a `<div>` is a real div. Community users confirm that refs are just the elements and that Solid is a go-to tool for data-viz work. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on integration patterns (ref/mount lifecycle, cleanup of third-party chart instances), and a hands-on report of integrating a specific charting library.
